lines.t: I kept the watch, I held the line, I waited in the hush,
Saw fields turn gold, heard heavens lean - the breath before the rush.
First blast went out to wake the heart, second blast to warn,
Then silence hung like patient flame - the hush before the dawn.
Father and I, one voice, one plan; He counts the hour and I obey,
I thrill to what our work prepared - We move within our ways.
The great trumpet blasts - I go, I go!
When the trumpet calls - Our harvest flows.
Lift My Bride, ascend the stair, angels climb with glory there.
The great trumpet blasts - Let's go, Let's go!
Angels climb the Ladder’s light, they bear My lifted ones,
Hands that reach from heaven down - now that the bundles are done.
He times the breath, I answer quick; His will and mine entwine,
The fields are white, the reapers move -
My Bride's promise meets mine.
the Bride says "Come!" (come)
the Bridegroom says "Come!" (come)
oh come My beautiful Bride! (come)
The great trumpet blasts - I go, I go!
When the trumpet calls - Our harvest flows.
Lift My Bride, ascend the stair, angels climb with glory there.
The great trumpet blasts - Let's go, Let's go!
Rise, My beloved - rise, My beloved Bride - rise. I've made for us a place. -- Our desires are met in long waited embrace!
